values.note: Online on the outfitter's Checkfront page ('Reserve Now') or by phone. Future stays take a 25% deposit, same-day stays full payment; max 2 items per reservation; cancel 7+ days out for a refund less $5, inside that the deposit is forfeited. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. Golf carts allowed; UTVs, ATVs and dirt bikes are not. 2027 RV Park dates showed 'UNAVAILABLE' on 2026-11-06 (season not yet loaded).

note: Outfitter's RV park on the Niangua River next to Bennett Spring State Park (open Mar-Oct): a grid of level concrete full-hookup pads beside the river, with the outfitter's store, float trips, cabins and a tent campground. --Claude
summary: Operator pages (browser) + Checkfront: confirmed $45 weekday / $55 weekend and dated it ('2024 Prices'), 50/30-amp full hookups, 101 RV-park sites, showers, coin laundry, store, no wifi; booking on Checkfront with deposit/cancellation terms.
